html:
Nha Trang to Dalat private car transfer is a high-quality door-to-door service for travelers from the beach city to the “city of love” Dalat. By booking transport with A/C private cars and English-speaking drivers, vacationers will have easy, hassle-free trips to Dalat from Nha Trang.

Nha Trang To Dalat Distance

Dalat and Nha Trang are two popular destinations among holidaymakers coming to Vietnam. While Nha Trang is famous for its exquisite beaches, Dalat appeals to visitors thanks to dreamy views of hills and valleys.

The distance from Nha Trang to Da Lat is ~212 km (132 miles). It is expected to take approximately 4,5 hours by car, following the CT01 route that connects to QL27, which is currently the fastest route. However, bad weather and heavy traffic can prolong your trip by 1 to 2 hours longer than expected.

How To Get To Dalat From Nha Trang

So, how to go from Nha Trang to Dalat? Transfers by bus, taxi, private car, or motorcycle are several of the most commonly chosen ways. However, we believe private car transfers bring the most conveniences and comfort.

It’s door-to-door, private, customizable, and flexible. You can get pick-ups and drop-offs right at your hotels in the cities without worrying about tickets, scams, extra costs, finding stations, changing vehicles, etc.

NHA TRANG TO DALAT PRIVATE CAR TRANSFER

Travel Briefing

  • Distance: 212km (~132 miles)
  • Travel Time: 4,5 – 5 hours
  • Pick-up Point: Hotel/Resort/Homestay in Nha Trang
  • Drop-off Point: Hotel/Resort/Homestay in Dalat
  • Types of Private Car: Sedan/SUV/Minivan/Limousine

Travel From Nha Trang To Dalat By Private Car

First of all, you make a booking with us and inform us of your preferred pick-up place, time, drop-off hotel, and other requests that you have. After confirming everything, our travel experts will arrange a private car and an excellent driver for you.

Later, our driver will pick you up at your requested hotel/homestay in Nha Trang City. He will welcome you to the car, help you with the luggage, and leave for Dalat.

During the 3-hour trip, you can ask him to stop for snacks, a short break, or a toilet. Our driver will be happy to drop by a suitable spot, so don’t worry about the long hours in the car.

Lastly, our driver will drop you off at your hotel in Dalat City. He will look around the car seat spaces to ensure you don’t forget anything and say goodbye.

Moreover, if you would like to do a Nha Trang day trip before getting to Dalat, we can set up a sightseeing tour by car for you, as follows:

We pick you up at your hotel in Nha Trang. Then, the car will take you to your requested attractions, such as Nha Trang beaches, Po Nagar Cham Towers, Stone Church, Nha Trang Institute of Oceanography, Hon Mun Marine Protected Area, Long Son Pagoda, etc. Finally, we transfer you to Dalat.

Don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any requests. We will try our best to meet your travel needs. Vietlook Travel looks forward to seeing you on our Nha Trang to Dalat private car journey.
